about_us.who_are_we_text: Havenly is a modern accommodation booking platform created by two passionate developers, Bence József Guvat and Máté János Herczeg, with the goal of making accommodation search and rental simpler, more transparent, and more enjoyable for all users.
about_us.havenly_mission_text: Our goal is to create a user-friendly website where booking and renting accommodations is fast, secure, and convenient. Havenly is not only a booking system, but also a community platform that connects travelers and hosts while helping users discover the hidden values and attractions of different locations.
about_us.havenly_offer_alt_title: Havenly provides users with the opportunity to:

havenly_offer.first_offer: book accommodations or upload and rent out their own properties after registration,
havenly_offer.second_offer: upload detailed accommodation descriptions, photos, and videos,
havenly_offer.third_offer: add local attractions and experiences to cities,
havenly_offer.fourth_offer: help other users make decisions through reviews,
havenly_offer.fifth_offer: securely manage their account and payment details,
havenly_offer.sixth_offer: easily modify or delete their accommodations and bookings.

about_us.booking_and_security_text: The website automatically manages bookings, eliminating scheduling conflicts and double bookings. Hosts receive instant notifications for each booking, and both parties have the option to cancel bookings under predefined conditions.
about_us.contact_and_communication_text: Havenly has its own messaging system that enables fast and easy communication between hosts and guests. Contact via email and phone is also available, as registration requires valid contact details.
about_us.multilingualism_and_future_text: The website will be available in multiple languages to provide an accessible and convenient solution for a wide range of users. Our long-term goal is for Havenly to become a reliable and continuously evolving platform that creates real value for both travelers and hosts.

intro.description_2: By using the Platform, the user (“User”, “You”) accepts these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the service.
